segments.text: Filling up at the petrol station. Engine off, open the flap, and grab the nozzle.
But at the pump next to you, a circus fire-breather is filling up. And he has the hiccups. What do you do?
Most drivers try to help, and shout: Boo!
Big mistake. He jumps, and hiccups the biggest flame of his life. Straight into your tank.
Three, two, one, lift-off! Your car is now a rocket. Over the town, and into the circus tent. Ta-da! You're the new human cannonball.
Here's how you do it properly.
Then pass him a glass of water. The circus cure: a handstand on the pump, and drink it upside down.
Hic. Just a tiny puff. Hiccups gone.
To say thanks, he breathes a heart of fire, and toasts a marshmallow on your antenna.
Next exam question: a giant tortoise comes from the right. Follow, so you don't miss it.
